statement: The system shall comply with all applicable regulatory requirements for e-Rx issuance.
The system shall retain all e-Rx records for at least two years from the date of their creation or receipt.
The system shall protect the integrity of e-Rx records from unauthorized alteration or destruction.
The system shall ensure that e-Rx records are easily readable and retrievable.
The system shall allow a prescriber to issue an electronic prescription for a patient.
The system shall ensure that only authorized prescribers can issue e-Rxs.
The system shall perform real-time drug-drug interaction and allergy contraindication checking at the point of ordering.
The system shall transmit the e-Rx to a community pharmacy through an e-prescribing intermediary.
The system shall allow the prescriber to change or cancel an e-Rx before it is transmitted.
The system shall authenticate the prescriber before allowing them to issue an e-Rx.
The system shall digitally sign the e-Rx with the prescriber's private key.
The system shall record the audit trail for all actions related to e-Rx issuance, including signing and transmission.
The system shall protect the confidentiality of patient information during e-Rx issuance.
The system shall provide an audit report for a specific time period and sort entries in the audit log.
